changes: Explicit capability-driven official one-shot MCP inventory, with no ACP session creation/load/prompt or Agent setting writes.
Available capability issues opaque UUID carrying exact AgentRow only in RAM (64 entries, fixed 300 seconds). New read supplies it and rechecks row before dispatch and publication.
Official registered Node relay only, fixed cli/mcp/list/--json arguments; cached login environment accessor never initializes a shell; no Farfold service or Keychain injection.
Bounded stdout/stderr, typed whitelist decoder, exact cancellation ownership, group/child/pipe cleanup and update/configuration permits held until real completion.

effectiveRed.finding: Row replacement before detached first metadata read was accepted as the replacement selection, returning its environment failure rather than selectionChanged.
effectiveRed.scope: Controlled MetaStore and synthetic public package; rejected before any real Agent or model process.
effectiveRed.greenAdaptation: The same replacement scenario now presents a capability receipt issued before the replacement; execute_selected receives its exact original row and rejects the current changed record.

intermediateCompileFailure.cause: uuid was not a direct dependency; corrected to existing getrandom UUID generation without dependency changes.

lastTestOnlyWireChange.scope: Added actual unavailable capability serialization to existing wire test; production unchanged from final 31 test pass.

wire.provenance: Actual Rust serialization from controlled subprocess/parser/request; capability unavailable emitted by real admission logic. Not an official CLI response or positive UI acceptance.

validation.clippyAndFullSuite: Not run here; root requested single integrated seven checks.

lifecycleBoundaries.activeRequestExpiry: Active entries are never evicted by entries.retain; cancellation tests prove active successor exclusion. Fixed-time selection expiry tests are direct clock inputs, not a five-minute wall-clock run.
lifecycleBoundaries.nullCancel: Exact cancel atomically registers a tombstone when no retained request exists. It does not prove a historical process stopped; later same-ID begin is refused while retained. Old UI requests keep the older selection ticket (its 300-second expiry is no later than the subsequently created cancellation tombstone expiry).
lifecycleBoundaries.drop: Actual observer abort while a TERM-ignoring owned process ran retained activity and same-Agent exclusion until group cleanup; terminal result then cancelled.
lifecycleBoundaries.timeout: Deadline requests cleanup. pendingCleanup is not settled; no guarantee an individual OS/SQLite call is interruptible.

securityBoundaries: No raw stdout/stderr, environment, headers, args, URL, helper or free-form CLI errors enter DTO/logs/files. Tests use explicit synthetic markers and verify exclusion.
Sensitive input is held in bounded private memory; selected output buffers are cleared but this is not a claim that every allocation, compiler copy or allocator memory is securely erased.
Safe user-given names may still contain arbitrary text; no classifier can guarantee arbitrary labels never contain a secret. URL/path/header-shaped names are replaced by null, row retained.
Path identity checks are not an atomic filesystem snapshot or immutable executable authentication.
RAM selection receipts are not durable configuration epochs or a second session/history ledger.
